idea: A WhatsApp bot that reminds dental clinic patients about appointments and collects deposits

strategist.problem: The clinic owner spends 30-45 minutes every morning manually calling or messaging 10-20 patients to confirm appointments, only to discover at 10 AM that 2-3 patients no-showed, resulting in a direct loss of ₹2,000-₹5,000 in billable chair time per incident.
strategist.target_customer: Owners of 1-3 dentist solo practices in Jaipur with 50-150 monthly patients who currently use WhatsApp personally for scheduling and lose at least 10% of booked slots to no-shows.
strategist.mission: Automate appointment confirmation and deposit collection via WhatsApp for solo dental clinics in Jaipur to eliminate no-shows and secure cash flow before the patient arrives.

competitors.name: Manual WhatsApp + Excel
competitors.differentiator: We replace the founder's 45-minute daily manual calling routine with an automated flow that confirms appointments and collects deposits while the founder is seeing other patients.

competitors.name: Generic Indian SaaS (e.g., Practo, DocVita)
competitors.differentiator: We are 10x cheaper and 100% focused on the two specific actions (reminder + deposit) that drive revenue, rather than forcing the clinic to adopt a full practice management suite with 50 unused features.

competitors.name: Local Freelance Developers
competitors.differentiator: We provide a standardized, pre-built SaaS subscription that works out-of-the-box in 24 hours, avoiding the ₹50,000+ one-time cost and 6-week timeline of custom local development.

scope_cuts: No full practice management system (no patient history, no X-ray storage, no billing invoices); we only handle the appointment confirmation and deposit link.
No voice call automation; we strictly use WhatsApp text and payment links to keep the API costs low and the implementation simple for the first 10 clinics.
No multi-language support beyond Hindi and English; Jaipur's dental demographic is primarily Hindi/English speaking, so we skip the complexity of regional language NLP for the MVP.

stack.name: Next.js (App Router)
stack.why: Full-stack React framework for the clinic dashboard and webhook handlers, deployable in one click.

stack.name: Supabase
stack.why: Postgres database and Auth for storing clinic data, patient records, and appointment states.

stack.name: Make.com (formerly Integromat)
stack.why: Fallback automation layer to trigger WhatsApp messages via API while Meta Cloud API verification is pending, enabling immediate pilot testing.

stack.name: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API
stack.why: Official API for sending automated appointment reminders and receiving patient replies (target state).

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: Payment gateway to generate deposit links and process UPI/card payments from patients.

stack.name: Vercel
stack.why: Hosting platform for Next.js with built-in CI/CD and webhook routing.

ai_tools.name: Cursor
ai_tools.why: AI code editor to scaffold the Next.js app and write Supabase queries quickly.

ai_tools.name: v0.dev
ai_tools.why: Generates React/Tailwind UI components for the clinic dashboard and patient view.

mvp_features: Automated WhatsApp reminder 24 hours before appointment with a one-tap 'Confirm' button.
Razorpay deposit link sent immediately upon confirmation, blocking the appointment if unpaid.
Clinic dashboard to view today's confirmed appointments and total deposits collected.
first_10_steps: Submit the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API business verification and template approval request immediately as a critical path dependency.
Run 'npx create-next-app@latest dental-bot --typescript --tailwind --app' to scaffold the project.
Create a Supabase project, generate the API key, and run 'npm install @supabase/supabase-js' to connect the database.
Design the database schema in Supabase Studio: tables for 'clinics', 'patients', 'appointments', and 'payments'.
Configure a Make.com scenario to act as the fallback messaging engine, connecting to a personal WhatsApp number via the WhatsApp API for immediate pilot testing.
Use Cursor to write the API route '/api/whatsapp' that parses incoming WhatsApp messages and updates appointment status.
Use v0.dev to generate the clinic dashboard UI with a table of today's appointments and a 'Send Reminder' button.
Integrate Razorpay by creating a Payment Link API call in the backend to generate a unique deposit URL per appointment.
Write a cron job in Vercel that triggers the WhatsApp reminder 24 hours before each scheduled appointment.
Deploy the application to Vercel and test the full flow using the Make.com fallback: create a test appointment, receive the WhatsApp message, pay the deposit.

pricing.name: Starter
features: Up to 100 WhatsApp reminders per month

pricing.name: Pro
features: Up to 300 WhatsApp reminders per month

revenue_targets.notes: 2 pilot clinics converted to paid + 1 new clinic from local dental association referral
3 additional clinics onboarded via word-of-mouth in Jaipur dental community
4 additional clinics onboarded; 2 clinics upgraded from Starter to Pro tier

key_assumptions: Solo dental clinic owners in Jaipur pay ₹1,500-₹2,500/month for tools that directly reduce no-shows, based on the ₹2,000-₹5,000 loss per no-show incident
Average revenue per customer is ₹1,999, assuming a 50/50 split between Starter (₹1,499) and Pro (₹2,499) tiers
Delivery cost per customer is ₹250/month, covering variable WhatsApp API message costs (approx. 150 messages x ₹0.008/message) and minor support time
Marketing budget of ₹5,000/month covers local dental association events, LinkedIn outreach to Jaipur dentists, and small Google Ads for 'dental appointment reminder software Jaipur'

channels.name: Google Maps Cold Voice Outreach
channels.tactic: Identify 50 solo dental clinics in Jaipur via Google Maps (filter: 1-3 chairs, 4.0+ stars). Send 20 personalized 30-second video demos (Loom) via WhatsApp daily to clinic owners. Follow up with a 1-minute voice note if no reply in 24h. Target: 50 direct conversations in first 10 days.

channels.name: Local Dental Supply Store Partnerships
channels.tactic: Visit 5 major dental supply stores in Jaipur (e.g., near Civil Hospital and Ajmer Road). Leave a QR code card at the counter linking to a 2-minute demo video. Ask the store owner to forward the link to 5 clinic owners who buy chairs/equipment weekly. Founder calls 10 store owners/day to track referrals.

first_10_customers: Day 1-3: Manually identify 50 solo dental clinics in Jaipur via Google Maps (search 'dentist Jaipur', filter 4.0+ stars, 1-3 chairs). Extract WhatsApp numbers from their websites or call the front desk to get the owner's direct number.

Day 4-10: Send 20 personalized 30-second video demos (Loom) via WhatsApp daily to clinic owners. Follow up with a 1-minute voice note if no reply in 24h. Target: 50 direct conversations to secure 3 initial pilots.

Day 11-20: Personally onboard the 3 pilot clinics. Set up the WhatsApp Business API, connect their Razorpay account, and manually verify the first 3 reminder flows. Ask for a 15-minute feedback call after 7 days.

Day 21-30: Convert the 3 pilots to paid Starter plans (₹1,499/month) by showing them the exact number of no-shows prevented during the pilot week. Ask each for 2 referrals to other dentists they know.
Day 31-45: Execute the supply store partnership tactic. Visit 5 stores, leave QR cards, and call 10 store owners daily to ask for leads. Target: 3 new clinics from store referrals.
Day 46-60: Follow up with the 6 referrals from the first 3 pilots. Close them as paid customers. Total: 10 paying customers (3 from direct outreach + 3 from stores + 4 from referrals).
growth.cold_message: Hi [Name], I built a WhatsApp bot that auto-confirms appointments and collects deposits for Jaipur dentists. It cuts no-shows by 40% and saves 30 mins/day. Want a free 7-day pilot for your next 10 patients? No setup fee.

objections.objection: I already use WhatsApp personally; why pay for a bot?
objections.response: Your manual calls take 45 mins/day and still miss 2-3 no-shows. The bot runs while you treat patients, guarantees confirmation, and collects the deposit upfront so you get paid even if they cancel. The ₹1,499 fee is less than the cost of one empty chair hour.

objections.objection: I don't trust a new software with my patient data.
objections.response: We only store appointment dates and phone numbers, not medical records. Your data stays on your WhatsApp Business API and Razorpay account; we don't sell or share it. You can delete all data with one click in the dashboard. Try the 7-day free pilot to see how it works before paying a rupee.

critic.verdict: The plan is strategically sound for a bootstrapped solo founder, correctly identifying a high-pain, low-competition niche in Jaipur. The technical stack is appropriate for the budget, and the growth strategy relies on high-effort, low-cost outreach that fits the founder's constraints. However, the financial model is dangerously optimistic regarding conversion rates and the feasibility of onboarding 10 customers in 90 days with a cold-start WhatsApp API.
critic.biggest_risk: The plan assumes a 20% conversion rate from cold outreach to paid customers within 30 days, which is highly unrealistic for a B2B SaaS with no social proof; the founder will likely spend the entire 90-day runway building the product and chasing leads without closing the 7 customers needed for break-even.
